beats.rationale: The changing number is itself the semantic hero and must move as weighted typography, not as a card.
The equation physically changing state communicates the distinction more directly than explanatory labels.
A single directed path makes token order and progression visible without a panel sequence.
A shared candidate axis shows relative next-token choices more honestly than separate decorative cards.
The causal error must visibly travel through dependent steps and alter their state in order.
The calculator terminal is the actual semantic tool and the path proves that computation was routed elsewhere.
Returning the computed value into the original equation preserves object continuity and closes the mechanism.
The final action rule should assemble as the final semantic object rather than sit inside another information card.
